decision: 10 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 3 for the 12 month period).
fact: Car 55 forced Car 12 off the track at turn 10.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, and in-car video evidence. At the entry to Turn 10 Car 55 locked the front wheels and understeered towards Car 12, missing the apex and forcing Car 12 off the track. Car 12 lost two positions as a result.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 55 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track Corrected
to: The Team Manager, Atlassian Williams Racing
